items.title: ESPHome Web Server Authentication Bypass Vulnerability Exposes Smart Devices
items.description: A critical security vulnerability discovered in ESPHome’s web server component has exposed thousands of smart home devices to unauthorized access, effectively nullifying basic authentication protections on ESP-IDF platform implementations. The flaw, designated CVE-2025-57808 with a CVSS score of 8.1, affects ESPHome version 2025.8.0 and allows attackers to bypass authentication mechanisms…

items.title: Amazon Stymies APT29 Credential Theft Campaign
items.description: A group linked to Russian intelligence services redirected victims to fake Cloudflare verification pages and exploited Microsoft's device code authentication flow.

items.title: WordPress Woes Continue Amid ClickFix Attacks, TDS Threats
items.description: Vulnerable and malicious plug-ins are giving threat actors the ability to compromise WordPress sites and use them as a springboard to a variety of cyber threats and scams.
